result.instructions: Use UniView open_files whenever the person asks to show, open, view, preview or see a file or document, including a file you just made, instead of printing its contents. Then call wait_for_user_message and act on what comes back as a request from the person. After editing, call open_files with the same path, then post_message with one short sentence, then wait again. Stop only when status is closed.
